lines.en: I show up at the mall a little later than usual after getting caught up in traffic.
Chika’s break should have already ended by now, so I guess I’ll wind up hanging out with her at her work again today.
Not like that’s a problem, though.
In fact, it might be good that I showed up late because it increases the chances of her taking her clothes off for me.
Obviously, she'd be putting on different clothes and not letting me watch the act of doing so- but either way. She is taking off her clothes for me.
And that is all I need to know.
: Heya! Welcome-
: Ah! Sensei!
: Great timing. I was just thinking about you.
: You mean you aren’t always thinking about me? Bummer.
: Cut me some slack, Sensei! If I spent literally all day thinking about you, I’d forget to come to work and lose my job and it would be like, a whole thing.
: Besides, there's no way you think about me even half as much as I think about you.
Sure I do. I just can't talk about the majority of those thoughts out loud.
: I suppose that you dedicating any amount of time to me is more than enough, but I still implore you to try and fit more in whenever possible.
: I'll see if I can pull some strings and make that happen.
: So, you ready?
: Ready for what?
: Seeing me try some stuff on, dummy! That's why you came, isn't it?
: I mean...that wasn't the only reason.
: Well, I'm ready whenever you are.
: Plus, I found a dress that I might actually look good in, so...
: Do you need any help putting it on?
: Mmm...no. I think I can handle that part myself. You can follow me over to the dressing room, though.
: And if there’s anything you wanna try on, just let me know. Maybe I can judge you after you do me?
: You can do me whenever you want, Chika.
: Thanks! Just follow me to the-
: Wait! No! I said a weird thing again! I didn't mean it like that!
: So...we're not going to do each other?
: Not yet!
: But doesn't that imply-
: Nope!
: Anyway! Time to get dressed!
Chika awkwardly shuffles her way over to a separate part of the store, straightening out her skirt and shaking off whatever nerves started acting up as a result of her inappropriate wording just now.
I have to do the same, but it's less awkward and I can't imagine it looking even half as attractive.
Either way, she stops in front of the dressing rooms before turning to face me.
: Okay, so. Disclaimer-
: I’ve already told you that dresses aren’t my thing...so even if I said that I like this one...please don’t expect too much.
: Deal.
: Great. Disclaimer part two-
: Make sure you wait until I’m done getting dressed to actually come in.
: I liked the first disclaimer more.
: I bet you did, Sensei.
: And remember- I’m still technically at work, even if there aren’t any customers right now.
: I hope there's not a third disclaimer stating that I need to help any of them while you're getting changed.
: Chika, I don't know how-
: Then, I guess all we can do is hope that nobody comes in!
: But yeah! Other than that, just don’t make fun of me when I look like a fish out of water and we'll be all good!
: Sounds easy enough. Apart from the idea of helping customers, I mean.
: Great! Then, hang out here for a couple minutes while I get dressed and...I'll see you soon.
: Sure thing. Let me know if your bra gets stuck and you need help getting it off.
: One of the hooks is already broken, so I doubt that'll be a problem. But thanks for the offer.
Chika disappears into the dressing room and I can hear her clothes beginning to fall to the floor moments later.
It takes every ounce of self-control I have to not sneak in there, but I respect Chika's wishes and remain outside.
I'm sure a day will come when I don't have to do that anymore but, for now, the best way for me to get closer to her is to respect the very few boundaries she actually establishes.
I know that, at the end of the day, she is taking her clothes off for me right now.
So I justify my wait by reiterating that single thought over and over in my head until the time finally comes to-
: Sensei! I'm...suddenly having second thoughts about this.
The time comes sooner than expected.
: What? Why?
: Because I look like a freaking idiot.
: Chika-
: Fine! Fine...
: You can come in, just...
: I'm sorry in advance for the disappointment...
I follow the sound of Chika's voice, slightly muffled by a thick red curtain-
And stumble upon a wonderful sight.
: Yeahhh, so...I kinda thought I’d look a little cuter than this...but it’s whatever, I guess.
: Dresses just aren’t my thing. I promise I’ll wear something more exciting next time.
: Maybe not something as exciting as lingerie, but...
: Don’t say that. Just because it's different from how you normally look doesn't mean it's bad.
: It doesn't mean it's good either, though...
: Like...how do you really think I look like dressed in stuff like this, Sensei? Be honest.
I think you look beautiful
: I think you’re beautiful, Chika.
: Yeah, that’s what I-
: Wait, what? Who? Me?
: What did you just say?
: I said I think you look beautiful.
: Yeah, but like...sarcastically, right? Like what you really think is that I resemble an out-of-place[teen]on her way to Easter breakfast with her grandparents.
: I would...never think something that specific. I just genuinely think you look great.
: You...You know that I’ll still like you even if you tell me the truth, right? You don't have to be nice 100%% of the time.
: I am telling you the truth.
: And you know I’ll still eventually do the lingerie thing even if you don’t compliment literally everything I ever wear, right?
: Just accept the compliment, Chika.
: Ahhhhh! I wanna! It’s just super embarrassing and I didn’t expect you to say anything good!
: Maybe you just...need to take a closer look or something?! I don't know!
: You wear glasses so your eyes are probably bad and-
: Fine.
: Nope. Still beautiful.
: Oh my God. A real kabedon. Am I dreaming?
: What?
: Nothing. Don't stop.
: Uhh...I don't really know what else there is to say other than you still look great.
: You’re not even looking at the dress anymore.
: Yeah. There's something else I like looking at a little more.
: Oh my fucking God, my hot teacher is kabedoning me. I'm in an anime. This isn't real.
Chika presses her back against the mirror not to get away, but to make herself more comfortable.
She's obviously surprised by me suddenly closing the distance like this...but she was the one who suggested it, so...
: Your...
: Has anyone ever told you how pretty your eyes are?...
: And like, not even just that...you're straight up really attractive up close...
: I'll make sure to get as close as I can when I flirt from now on, then.
: Do you...really not have a girlfriend?
: I already told you. I’m preoccupied with a bunch of [teenager]s instead.
: Sorry, I just...
: My heart’s beating out of control right now and it’s kinda hard to remember stuff.
: Is it?
: Uh-huh...
: And why is that, Chika?
: Oh, I don't know, Sensei! Why do you think?!
: Is that sass I hear right now?
: Are you gonna give me detention if I say yes?
: I am now. Please drop by my office after[school] as soon as possible.
: What are you gonna make me do, Sensei?
: I guess we’ll find out soon enough, won’t we?
: Is it wrong for me to be a little excited?
: Do you want the real answer or the hotter one?
: Gimme the hotter one.
: Then, no.
: I've never had a detention before, Sensei. You might have to give me directions.
This is so much better than lingerie.
I bring my hand to Chika’s face, not knowing exactly how she'll react but, as you can see, it works out pretty favorably.
: About time.
: Am I moving too slow for you?
: Yes.
: Ahm~
Oh.
Oh, okay.
: Mnh...mmm...
: Mnch...mmm...
In a welcome turn of events, Chika slowly and gently wraps her tongue around my thumb, sensually taking as much of it into her mouth as she can.
To say I'm shocked is a bit of an understatement, but she's been more or less full of surprises thus far and the idea of her being into things like this isn't too absurd.
And again, this is so much better than lingerie.
: Mm...mm...you like that, Sensei?...
: This is...amf...what you wanted...right?...
: Oh my God. Please tell me I didn't just dramatically misread the situation.
: Cause I really thought that was where we were going with that and-
: No, it's just...I'm a little surprised.
: I thought you were innocent, is all.
: I am innocent!
: The saliva all over my thumb begs to differ.
: That's...I don't know, Sensei! It seemed like the right thing to do at the time!
: I just got worried that you were talking about an actual detention when you stopped talking and just let me keep going and...and...
: And your thumbs are big! You should...apologize! For...for having such...
: Such...large...
: I'm going back to work now!
Chika storms out of the dressing room and, once I follow her out, she begs me for the next ten minutes to forget any of that ever happened.
Well, not any of it- but the part where she started fellating my finger.
Regardless, it’s clear now that there’s at least some form of chemistry between us.
What that chemistry is remains to be determined.
But once it reaches its full potential-
I can see Chika becoming someone I'll never forget.
Oh, and also, she is good with her tongue.
Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!
I think you look fine
: I think you look fine.
: Sure, it’s not as fitting as your normal clothes, but you’re still adorable.
: Guh...Maybe if I started, like...styling my hair differently, I could pull stuff like this off?
: I’m sure makeup plays some part in it too, but that's like, a crazy amount of work.
: Sorry for subjecting you to this, Sensei. Just can't help but feel like I should maybe try and change up my image every once in a while.
: What are you apologizing for? I don't see anything wrong with your normal style.
: I don't know. It's just that the whole gyaru thing attracts some unwanted attention at times.
: Plus, you hanging around with a girl who looks like I do might...send some bad signals out or something.
: Dress however you want to dress, Chika. Don't tailor your style to fit me or anyone else.
: If you like it, wear it. That's really all there is to it.
: Yeah...Yeah, that's a good point.
: As long as you don’t think I look weird or whatever, I’ll probs just keep dressing how I have been.
: It would suck having to buy a whole new wardrobe anyway...
: At least if you start saving now, you might be able to afford something here by the time you retire.
: Hahah! Yeah...maybe.
: Well, uhh...I guess I should probably be getting back to doing my job or whatever now.
: You’re sure no one saw you follow me in here, right?
: I...don’t remember checking, actually.
: Oh well. We've been slow all day anyway, so I doubt there were any customers while we were in here.
: Just...you go out first and I'm sure everything will be alright. I still need to put my regular clothes back on anyway.
: It's fine. I'll stay for that part. I want to understand your process.
: You will most certainly not stay for that part, Sensei.
: Well, you can't blame me for trying.
I exit the dressing room and Chika comes out a minute or two later.
We chat for a little while longer before her boss calls and she needs to go over some inventory stuff with her.
As such, I exit the store and am once again subjected to aimlessly wandering the streets of Kumon-mi...
Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!
